author: /root/swahili_translation
paired_descriptions: All first/second rows read as complete intended sentences, including food, barracks, school, swimming pool, tower and wall descriptions.

references.inspection: Read actual animate-agreement discussion and examples; animate noun shape need not determine agreement.
Read actual software tone, compounds, noun agreement, abbreviations and procedure guidance critically; outdated programming-quote prescriptions do not override repository syntax.
Read publication identity and actual moss(es)=kuvumwani entry (page33/printed32); attested educational term, not rejected merely because unfamiliar.
Read Thilo Schadeberg lexical record: mzinga specifically man-made cylindrical beehive/cannon; not inherently a better creature-production label than a nest.
Inspected retrieved lexical entry for kiota (viota), nest/laying place; historical evidence used only for core meaning, not modern software style.

accepted_context_decisions: Swarm=Kiota/Viota accepted as a game-specific nest/production-structure term, reinforced by Huzalisha viumbe wapya. Do not translate as troop-group or force beehive-specific Mzinga merely because another language uses hive.
Moss=Kuvumwani accepted: explicitly attested in primary educational biology glossary.
Animate viumbe use hawawezi/hawapatikani/wako/wana; singular kiumbe uses amejiunga. Pilot fixes present and correctly preserved.
Corn key source is Wheat and becomes Ngano; food-labeled statistics source values correctly become Chakula, avoiding source-key guesses.
All tutorial numbers/directions and production, feeding, upgrades, unit counts were compared; remaining specific findings recorded.
Makazi is collective ma-class; standard ya- agreement is generally consistent, with one explicit source-key finding for kila makazi lina. Eneo la makazi halina is correct because subject is eneo.
limitations: Visual wrapping, UI length, accessibility and platform verification remain separate acceptance gates.
